entities.name: Tudhaliya IV
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tudḫaliya IV was a king of the Hittite Empire, and the younger son of Ḫattušili III. He reigned c. 1245–1215 BC. His mother was the great queen, Puduḫepa.
